raw_html: [[Axiomatic Burst#Axiomatic Burst|Axiomatic Burst]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Axiomatic Burst#Axiomatic Burst|Axiomatic Burst]]:''' An axiomatic weapon is lawfully aligned and infused with the power of law. It makes the weapon law-aligned and thus bypasses the corresponding damage reduction. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against all of chaotic alignment and an extra 3 to 18 on a critical for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 4 to 24 for a x3 multiplier, and 5 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
